_readme: WhatsApp templates for the Beauty Voucher campaign. Every template here is submitted to
Meta for approval before it can send.
submit        the body that gets submitted. Hard cap 1024 characters. Required.
longer_draft  optional fuller alternative, kept for reference only. Never submitted,
so it is allowed to be over the cap.
buttons       quick replies. Max 3, and each label max 25 characters.
build-previews.py validates all of the above on every run and refuses to write the data
file if any of it breaks - so an unsubmittable template cannot reach the approval pack.
Both caps are enforced by Meta at SUBMISSION, not at send: an over-length template is
simply rejected and the workflow step silently has nothing to send.
[Name] is the {{1}} variable and stays a placeholder: Meta counts the variable, not the
name. [voucher link] is NOT a placeholder any more. It is resolved from the links block
below before anything is counted, because Meta counts the literal characters of a static
URL in the body. Change the URL there once and every character count, every preview and
every copy-to-clipboard follows. build-previews.py fails the build on any [placeholder]
